rows.text: The Lok Sabha Secretariat's journal reports that on 21 July 1992 members of Parliament held a function in the Central Hall to bid farewell to the outgoing President, Shri R. Venkataraman; the Speaker presented a Farewell Address, which speaks of the eve of his laying down the office he had held for five years.

locator.item: Addresses, 1: 'Farewell Address presented to Shri R. Venkataraman, President of India, by Members of Parliament on 21 July 1992', editor's note and opening paragraph

rows.text: The journal's article on the Tenth Presidential Elections (by C.K. Jain) reports polling on 13 July 1992 and counting on 16 July in Parliament House: of 4,451 votes (value 1,043,387), 67 (value 17,199) were invalid; Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma polled 2,865 votes valued at 675,864, Prof. G.G. Swell 1,502 valued at 346,485, Shri Ram Jethmalani 13 valued at 2,704 and Kaka Joginder Singh 4 valued at 1,135, and Dr. Sharma was declared elected.

locator.item: Article 'The Tenth Presidential Elections', C.K. Jain, paragraphs on polling and counting, and Table II

rows.text: The journal reports that Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma was sworn in as President of India on 25 July 1992 by the Chief Justice of India, Mr. Justice M.H. Kania, at a solemn function in the Central Hall of Parliament; a photograph caption shows the Chief Justice administering the oath of office that day.

locator.item: Editor's note to 'Address by Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma on his assumption of office as President of India on 25 July 1992'; photo caption facing page 310; closing paragraph of the article on page 337

rows.text: The journal reproduces the address Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma delivered in the Central Hall after the swearing-in, headed as his address on assumption of office as President on 25 July 1992; he opens by saying he has entered upon the office of President and refers to the oath he has made and subscribed.

locator.item: Addresses, 3: heading, editor's note and first and fourth paragraphs of the address

rows.text: The same article says that Shri R. Venkataraman assumed office on 25 July 1987 and remained in office till 25 July 1992, and that Dr. Shanker Dayal Sharma was sworn in as the ninth President on 25 July 1992.

locator.item: Article 'The Tenth Presidential Elections', paragraph listing past Presidents

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
